name: Question 1
problem:
A tank initially holds $500\,\text{L}$ of a brine (salt-water) solution containing $12\,\text{kg}$ of salt.
A brine solution containing $0.02\,\text{kg}$ of salt per liter is poured into the tank at a rate of $15\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed brine leaves the tank at a rate of $20\,\text{L/min}.$ Which differential equation best describes the amount of salt $Q,$ in kilograms, in the tank $t$ minutes after the brine begins to be added?

Question 1
?

A tank initially holds 500L of a brine (salt-water) solution containing 12kg of salt. A brine solution containing 0.02kg of salt per liter is poured into the tank at a rate of 15L/min, while the completely mixed brine leaves the tank at a rate of 20L/min. Which differential equation best describes the amount of salt Q, in kilograms, in the tank t minutes after the brine begins to be added?

a
dQdt+1100−tQ=310
b
dQdt−3100−tQ=310
c
dQdt−4100−tQ=310
d
dQdt+4100−tQ=310
e
dQdt+3100−tQ=310
Submit
